decisions.say: Any action that removes data or moves money MUST confirm first.
decisions.because: in shared accounts the harm falls on the person who did not act.
decisions.not: immediate action with an undo message.
decisions.do: a dialog that names the consequence.

decisions.say: A legal notice MUST be shown word for word, as written in `history/legal-notices.md`.
decisions.because: a shortened notice is not the notice the regulator approved.
decisions.not: a summary, a tooltip or a link in place of the text.
decisions.do: the full text, visible without an extra tap, before the action it concerns.

decisions.say: An icon-only button MUST have an accessible name.
decisions.because: a screen-reader user cannot use a button that has no name.
decisions.not: relying on the icon or a tooltip alone.
decisions.do: set the label in the component API.

decisions.say: Row actions in a table SHOULD take effect at once and offer an undo message.
decisions.because: a dialog on every row action slows down people who manage long lists.
decisions.not: a confirmation dialog for an action that can be reversed.
decisions.do: an undo message that stays for ten seconds.

decisions.say: Screens not yet migrated MAY keep the previous table until the migration ends.
decisions.because: rebuilding every table at once would block two releases.
